description:
Hey there, fellow space apps participants! Our team, Team Hustlers, is tackling the Flame in Freefall challenge and we are looking for passionate members to join us!

I bring strong skills in AI, data engineering, and full-stack development. I am looking for team members with experience in front-end or full-stack development, data engineering and visualization, microgravity research, or technical writing. If you are excited about space tech and AI, come build with us!
